mapper.select:
SELECT es.employee_skill_id AS employeeSkillId, s.category_code AS categoryCode, s.skill_name AS skillName, es.experience_months AS experienceMonths, es.skill_level AS skillLevel, es.last_used_ym AS lastUsedYm, es.remarks AS remarks
FROM employee_skills es INNER JOIN skills s ON s.skill_id = es.skill_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE es.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND es.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.category_code ASC, s.skill_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_skills ( employee_id, skill_id, experience_months, skill_level, last_used_ym, remarks, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{request.skillId}, #{request.experienceMonths}, #{request.skillLevel}, NULLIF( #{request.lastUsedYm}, '' ), NULLIF( #{request.remarks}, '' ), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy} )
